response.sql: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), shares AS (SELECT link_to_major, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS share FROM major_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, a.avg_share FROM shares s, avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_members, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_above_average FROM above;
